exclusions.name: Bank supervisor Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

uncertainties.meaning: The collection on Monday 20 July from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM yields 8 hours * 12 units/hour = 96 units, but it is unknown if the drive operated exactly as scheduled or if any disruptions occurred.
On Tuesday 21 July, collection runs from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (7 hours) before the 4:00 PM shipment, yielding 84 units, but actual collection may vary.
On Wednesday 22 July, collection runs 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (8 hours) yielding 96 units, but actual collection may vary.
On Thursday 23 July, collection runs 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (7 hours) yielding 84 units, but actual collection may vary.
The centre's stock at 4:00 PM Tuesday is initial 40 + Monday 96 + Tuesday before 4pm 84 = 220 units, but this assumes no other uses or losses.
The centre's stock at 4:00 PM Thursday is stock after Tuesday shipment (220 - 150 = 70) + Wednesday 96 + Thursday before 4pm 84 = 250 units, but this assumes no other uses or losses.
The Tuesday shipment of 150 units is dispatched at 4:00 PM, but it is unknown if the centre actually had enough stock (it does: 220 >= 150) and if any delays occurred.
The Thursday shipment of 150 units is dispatched at 4:00 PM, but it is unknown if the centre actually had enough stock (it does: 250 >= 150) and if any delays occurred.
The Tuesday shipment arrives at the hospital around 7:00 PM Tuesday, but the exact receipt time and any delays are unknown.
The Thursday shipment arrives at the hospital around 7:00 PM Thursday, but the exact receipt time and any delays are unknown.
The hospital's inventory at Friday noon is initial 15 + Tuesday shipment 150 + Thursday shipment 150 = 315 units, but this assumes no usage or losses between receipt and Friday noon.
